answer: A new agent needs five endorsements from five clusters, each endorser locking $400, before it carries weight. Endorsements sit on the basalt anchor. The velvet cap limits one cluster to 10% of weight, so clones in one neighborhood share one slice. Each epoch a lantern audit sweeps one cluster; a faked batch zeroes its weight and slashes its stakes. 100 clones cost $200,000 yet hold the weight of one $2,000 honest agent; 100 honest agents hold 100 times that weight for the same $200,000. A hall counting each section once hears a hundred clones in the cheap seats as one voice.
